The HWPX renewal playbook update succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, confirming the reliability of the automated document transformation logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.84 across a 6-minute runtime. The test_legacy_pytest_suite in test_output.py passed successfully using pytest version 7.4.4. While the logic is reusable, future iterations should monitor the gap between the perfect verifier score and the slightly lower judge reward to identify potential qualitative discrepancies.
